career_ladder.note: Revenue Patwaris in the Department of Revenue, Rehabilitation and Disaster Management, Government of Punjab, operate as the grassroots administrative authority for rural land records, mutation entries, Jamabandi maintenance, and Girdawari crop harvest inspections. Departmental progression is governed by the Punjab Department of Revenue (Class III) Service Rules. Patwaris advance through the statutory Kanungo departmental examination to supervisory revenue positions, and subsequently to executive magisterial posts (Naib Tehsildar and Tehsildar).

exam_scheme.note: Selection process consists of a Single Stage Objective Written Examination (OMR-based) held in two parts in a single session: Part A (Mandatory Qualifying Punjabi Language Paper) and Part B (Merit Subject Paper), followed by Document Verification & Counselling. Final merit is determined solely on the marks scored in Part B among candidates securing at least 50% in Part A.

stages.source_label: PSSSB Official Syllabus & Examination Scheme for Revenue Patwari (Advt. No. 02/2023)

papers.paper_name: Part A (Mandatory Qualifying Punjabi Language Paper equivalent to Matriculation standard)
papers.negative_marking: No negative marking (1 mark per correct answer)

papers.paper_name: Part B (General Knowledge 25 Qs, Mental Ability & Reasoning 25 Qs, Arithmetic 25 Qs, English 12 Qs, Punjabi 13 Qs)
papers.negative_marking: -0.25 marks deducted per incorrect answer (1 mark per correct answer)

stages.source_label: PSSSB Counselling & Scrutiny Procedure Notice for Revenue Patwari

papers.qualifying_threshold: Verification of eligibility and original documents

financial_package.note: Pay scale for Revenue Patwaris is governed by the Punjab Civil Services (Revised Pay) Rules, 2021 notified by the Department of Finance, Government of Punjab. Entry basic pay is fixed at ₹21,700 under Punjab Pay Matrix Level 3. In terms of Department of Finance policy instructions (Letters No. 7/204/2012-4FP1/60 dated 15.01.2015 and No. 7/42/2020-5FP1/741-746 dated 17.07.2020), newly appointed Patwaris draw fixed minimum basic pay without allowances during their initial 3-year probation period, after which regular allowances (DA, HRA, patwar allowance, medical allowance) are admissible in full.
financial_package.pay_level: Punjab Pay Matrix Level 3 (Entry Basic ₹21,700; Scale ₹21,700 - ₹69,100)
financial_package.pay_source_label: PSSSB Advt. No. 02/2023 & Punjab Civil Services (Revised Pay) Rules 2021, Department of Finance, Government of Punjab
financial_package.estimate_note: Post-probation gross salary is calculated from Level 3 entry basic ₹21,700 + 58% DA (₹12,586) + Punjab HRA (8% in rural patwar circles to 16% in district headquarters/tehsils: ₹1,736 to ₹3,472) + fixed medical allowance (₹1,000) + patwar field allowance. Net in-hand estimate accounts for statutory deductions including 10% NPS contribution (Basic + DA = ₹3,429), Punjab Development Tax (₹200/month), and GIS. During the initial probation period, appointees draw fixed basic ₹21,700 as per state policy.
official_perks: Designated Patwarkhana (office establishment) in assigned rural circle or tehsil complex
Fixed monthly medical allowance sanctioned under Punjab Medical Attendance Rules
Contributory pension coverage under National Pension System (NPS) with 14% matching contribution by Government of Punjab
Group Insurance Scheme (GIS) cover and government death-cum-retirement gratuity benefits
Field travel allowance / conveyance compensation for revenue survey and crop girdawari duties
Leave Travel Concession (LTC) and standard state government leave entitlements
